title: Fold Core's 409-line contract into one short page
goal: One short contract per repository (foundation plan, phase 7): the page an agent reads first says what Core is, how work lands and the rules that hold, and the tests pin those rules, not retired wording

reuse.searched: The rules come from Core's own AGENTS.md, kept word for word; the shape follows the one-page contract the private product adopted the same day. No new code: the change removes text and two compiled copies of it.
